written: 2026-09-29, before any result of these universes was computed (owner asked whether small/mid caps help).
hypothesis: Adding a mid-cap ETF (IJH, S&P 400) and a small-cap value ETF (IJS, S&P 600 Value) as trend 6 sleeves improves return at the -15% drawdown budget.
rule: Trend 6 as built: each ETF gets an equal share, held while its dividend-adjusted month-end price is above the mean of its last 6 month-end prices, otherwise that share is in T-bills. 10 bps per side, month-end signals traded at that close.
benchmark: BASE = TREND6-EW-U8 (SPY QQQ IWM EFA EEM GLD IEF TLT, 12.5% each)
data: Total returns (adj_close), T-bills = ^IRX/252 lagged a day, long-only, no leverage
gate: BASE must reproduce the sweep's TREND6-EW-U8: 7.0% CAGR, -9.6% max DD (2008-01..2026-06)

pass_rule.adopt_U10_if: its return at -15% (k <= 1, rest T-bills) beats BASE by more than 0.5%/yr over 2008-2026/06 AND it has the higher CAGR in at least 3 of the 4 periods AND its full-period max DD is no more than 2 points deeper
pass_rule.otherwise: keep U8; U9 variants are reported, not decided on

consequences.adopt: Propose adding IJH and IJS sleeves to the trend 6 branch (not live) for the owner's OK.
consequences.keep: No change; answer: small/mid caps don't improve the core.
